tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: ground-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, fields and menus that sit on `ground`.

tokens.name: ground-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table headers and code on `ground`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges. Decoration only, below 3 to 1.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of fields and other controls. 3 to 1 on every ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `ground`, `ground-raised` and `ground-sunken`. 7 to 1.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Captions and secondary copy on the three grounds. 4.5 to 1.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels on `ground` and `ground-raised`. 3 to 1, never for copy that must be read.

tokens.name: root
tokens.usage: Fill, 620 nm. Use for the brand's own voice: the mark, one emphasis per layout, the key number. 3 to 1 on `ground` and `ground-raised`.

tokens.name: root-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the root hue on the three grounds and on `root-wash`. 4.5 to 1.

tokens.name: on-root
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `root` fill. 4.5 to 1.

tokens.name: root-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted background for a root notice or tag. Pair with `root-ink`.

tokens.name: third
tokens.usage: Fill, 496 nm. Use for in tune: success, a result that arrived, a metric going the right way. 3 to 1 on `ground` and `ground-raised`.

tokens.name: third-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the third hue on the three grounds and on `third-wash`. 4.5 to 1.

tokens.name: on-third
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `third` fill. 4.5 to 1.

tokens.name: third-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted background for a third notice or tag. Pair with `third-ink`.

tokens.name: fifth
tokens.usage: Fill, 413 nm. Use for the overtone: links, focus, information. 3 to 1 on `ground` and `ground-raised`.

tokens.name: fifth-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the fifth hue on the three grounds and on `fifth-wash`. 4.5 to 1.

tokens.name: on-fifth
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `fifth` fill. 4.5 to 1.

tokens.name: fifth-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted background for a fifth notice or tag. Pair with `fifth-ink`.

tokens.name: offkey
tokens.usage: Fill, 581 nm. Use for off key: a warning, something drifting. 3 to 1 on `ground` and `ground-raised`.

tokens.name: offkey-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the offkey hue on the three grounds and on `offkey-wash`. 4.5 to 1.

tokens.name: on-offkey
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `offkey` fill. 4.5 to 1.

tokens.name: offkey-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted background for a offkey notice or tag. Pair with `offkey-ink`.

tokens.name: clip
tokens.usage: Fill, 620 nm, the root hue at lower lightness. Use for clipping: an error, something that failed. 3 to 1 on `ground` and `ground-raised`.

tokens.name: clip-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the clip hue on the three grounds and on `clip-wash`. 4.5 to 1.

tokens.name: on-clip
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `clip` fill. 4.5 to 1.

tokens.name: clip-wash
tokens.usage: Tinted background for a clip notice or tag. Pair with `clip-ink`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3 to 1 on every ground.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: a cover or a hero line.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Brand kit, then calendar, then posts

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The opening paragraph under a headline.
styles.sample: We take what a business means and work out how its buyers say it.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running copy. Keep lines near 65 characters.
styles.sample: Free until the first customer arrives.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside running copy, and button labels.
styles.sample: 3 posts a day, 2 videos a week

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Counted from the first post on 2 October

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Tables, codes and figures inside copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels over a value or a section.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, tag padding. The fundamental.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its field. Up an octave from the step below.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and field padding. Up a fifth from the step below.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, gaps in a form. Up a fourth from the step below.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between cards. Up a fifth from the step below.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section. Up a fourth from the step below.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones. Up a fifth from the step below.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections. Up a fourth from the step below.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom, around a hero. Up a fifth from the step below.

radius.note: The wordmark's stroke ends in a half circle, so controls do too.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Tags, checkboxes, small marks.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Fields, notices, menus.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Buttons and pills: a half circle at each end, like the letters' stroke.

shadow.note: No drop shadows. Height is shown by a lighter ground and a hairline.

tokens.name: ring-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring where an outline cannot be used: a 2px gap in `ground`, then 2px of `fifth`.

stroke.note: The mark and the letters share one stroke: 16 units on an x-height of 100.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers and card edges.

tokens.name: stroke-firm
tokens.usage: Field borders on focus, the focus ring, chart lines. An octave above the hairline.

time.note: Each duration is a fifth longer than the one before: 120 ms times 3/2.

tokens.name: time-1
tokens.usage: Hover and press on small controls.

tokens.name: time-2
tokens.usage: Fields, tags, toggles.

tokens.name: time-3
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, notices arriving.

tokens.name: time-4
tokens.usage: Page-level moves and the mark settling.

ease.note: One curve. It passes the target by 4% and comes back, like a struck plate settling.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Every transition. Under reduced motion, cut the move and keep the end state.
